newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.

text.p: Traded volume rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange (LuSE) in the week ended October 4 led by newly-listed Zambia Sugar plc, exchange officials said.
They said volume rose to 104,653 shares valued at 1,510,173 kwacha, up from 94,550 shares worth 1,874,775 shares the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 15 kwacha and saw a traded volume of 65,251 shares valued at 909,765 kwacha.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 55 kwacha and swa 4,580 shares worth 251,900 kwacha.
Rothmans fell one kwacha to end the week at 34 kwacha in a traded volume of 12 shares worth 408 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines and Farmers House saw no trades in the week.
